title: Juicy Army: Prologue
description:
FULL GAME

Об игреJuicy army is the sweetest action roguelike set in a dream universe where you'll have to fight an army of juicy creatures!Prologue Features:
• Discover a world full of delicious treats! This fantasy kingdom is made of sweet and delightful objects! There are 5 biomes - Strawberry, Cheese, Candy, Donut, and Chocolate.

• Exotic fruity enemies! There are flying grapes, bouncing orange, sniper apple, pineapple bandit, and a lot of other juicy creatures. But don't let their cute appearance fool you! They may look cute, but they can get vicious quickly!

• As you progress, you'll find loads of interesting weapons. 

• Throughout your journey, you'll unlock new items, each with different strengths. Harness the power of these new abilities and smash through all obstacles!

• Responsive, fluid, and fun to play combat system!

• Procedurally generated worlds blended with handcrafted design elements to keep each run fresh and unique.

• Beautiful and adorable art style!
description_short: Juicy army is the sweetest action roguelike set in a dream universe where you'll have to fight an army of juicy creatures!
